issues.issue: Did the RPD reasonably make the negative credibility finding on the visa-form work-location contradiction and extend it to the documents?
issues.applicant_position: Credibility finding on visa-form work-location contradiction was unreasonable; misreading of the question, Rasheed on false information to escape, and documents wrongly discounted.
issues.respondent_position: Explanations (misreading the question, psychological state) were never raised before the RPD; document weight was reasonable given credibility.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that a reviewable error arises with respect to the RPD’s credibility findings or its treatment of the Access News Magazine article.

issues.issue: Was the RPD's finding that the claim is manifestly unfounded (s. 107.1) reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: A misstatement on a visa form, made to escape persecution, should not make the claim manifestly unfounded; relies on Yuan.
issues.result_quote: the RPD reasonably determined that his claim was manifestly unfounded.
